sessionName: Week 3 - Demand generation beyond the core PE houses
summary: George Berrington reviewed with Chris and Leanne where new work comes from. Almost all leads are referrals from operating partners, with very little outbound. We agreed a targeted outbound programme to operating partners at mid-market PE houses and a small events plan.

discussion.keyPoints: Leanne's data showed 31 qualified opportunities in 12 months, 24 of them from the three core PE houses or partner referrals. Website inbound was almost nil.
Chris was reluctant to cold contact operating partners, worried it looks junior. Agreed outbound should be partner-to-partner and insight led, not SDR style.
Meridian has sponsored a regional manufacturing awards night for three years with no traceable work. Leanne thinks a small operating partner roundtable would do better.

recommendations.recommendation: Chris and two senior partners each contact 10 operating partners per month at mid-market PE houses, with a short note on a relevant sector insight.
Replace the manufacturing awards sponsorship with two operating partner roundtables a year in Birmingham, capped at 12 guests.
Use a 4-touch sequence over 6 weeks: insight note, LinkedIn connection, roundtable invite, follow-up call.
Rebuild the website around the PE value-creation proposition before spending on any paid search.

actions.action: Build the target list of 120 operating partners at mid-market PE houses

nextFocus: Tighten the sales process from first meeting to signed engagement letter.
nextPreparation: Chris to bring the last five proposals, won and lost.

tests.question: What did we agree on outbound?
What are we doing instead of the awards sponsorship?
